measurement.ieeg_coordinates: from a separate spot check of 37 iEEG datasets; first electrode rows only

bids_validator_bundled_schema.note: NEMAR runs the validator without a schema option, so it checks against its bundled schema (BIDS 1.11.1). For every item here the levels are the same as in 1.11.2; the validator text was read at tag 3.0.2.

fields.id: stable kebab-case identifier, unique across items; never reused
fields.file: display label for the file column of the documentation tables
fields.key: display label for the item (keys, columns or the property checked)
fields.target: machine form: files is a list of path globs or suffixes relative to the dataset root (all must match for file-pair), keys lists JSON keys, columns lists TSV columns
fields.condition: when the item applies, or, for CONDITIONAL, the rule that sets the level; null when unconditional
fields.level_note: qualifier of the level that is not a condition (where the level comes from, or a sub-rule)
fields.tier_note: why the tier is a judgment call, when it is one
fields.metric_definition: what the measured rate counts; null when not measured

bids_levels.REQUIRED: BIDS REQUIRED (under condition, if one is given)
bids_levels.RECOMMENDED: BIDS RECOMMENDED (under condition, if one is given)
bids_levels.OPTIONAL: BIDS OPTIONAL (under condition, if one is given)
bids_levels.CONDITIONAL: the level itself depends on the dataset; condition states the rule
bids_levels.VALUE_QUALITY: the key or column meets its BIDS level already; the item asks for a better value than BIDS demands

check_types.presence: the files exist, and each listed key or column exists
check_types.non-n/a: present, and the value (for a column, at least one row) is not n/a, empty or unknown
check_types.numeric: present, and the value is a number
check_types.named-enum: the value is a named keyword from the schema enumeration, not Other
check_types.levels-present: categorical code columns are described with Levels or HED in the JSON sidecar
check_types.columns-described: every non-standard TSV column is described in the JSON sidecar
check_types.strict-json: the file parses with a strict JSON parser (UTF-8, no raw control characters)
check_types.min-length: the file is longer than 150 bytes
check_types.judgment: needs a human reader; no mechanical check settles it
